Package foms.controller

Class MenuController

java.lang.Object
foms.controller.MenuController
public class MenuController extends Object
The MenuController class manages menu items within different branches of a food management system. It allows adding, removing, and editing menu items for each branch. Used by manager to edit the menu for the branch that he belongs to

2024-04-15

  • Method Details

    • addItemToMenuList

      public static boolean addItemToMenuList(String itemName, double itemPrice, String branchName, String category, String description, boolean availability)
      Adds a new item to the menu of a specified branch.
      Parameters:
      itemName - The name of the menu item.
      itemPrice - The price of the menu item.
      branchName - The name of the branch to add the menu item to.
      category - The category of the menu item.
      description - The description of the menu item.
      availability - The availability of the menu item.
      Returns:
      true if the item was added successfully, false if the item already exists or the branch was not found.

    • removeItemFromMenuItemList

      public static void removeItemFromMenuItemList(String branchName)
      Initiates the process to remove a menu item from a branch's menu. It prints the menu and prompts the user to select an item to remove. It utilise removeItemFromMenu to remove an item
      Parameters:
      branchName - The name of the branch from which to remove a menu item.

    • addItemToMenu

      public static void addItemToMenu(String branch)
      Adds a new item to the menu after collecting item details from the user. Details include: name, price, category, description and availability
      Parameters:
      branch - The name of the branch to which the menu item will be added.

    • removeItemFromMenu

      public static boolean removeItemFromMenu(String itemName, String branchName)
      Removes a menu item from a branch's menu based on the item name.
      Parameters:
      itemName - The name of the menu item to be removed.
      branchName - The name of the branch from which the menu item will be removed.
      Returns:
      true if the item was removed successfully, false if the item was not found or the branch was not found.

    • printMenuListTable

      public static void printMenuListTable(String branchName)
      Prints a tabular list of menu items for a specific branch.
      Parameters:
      branchName - The name of the branch whose menu items will be printed.

    • editMenuItem

      public static void editMenuItem(String branchName)
      Initiates the process to edit a menu item from a branch's menu. It prints the menu and prompts the user to select an item to edit and then the aspect of the item to edit.
      Parameters:
      branchName - The name of the branch where the menu item will be edited.
